verdict.rationale: GA4 has documented public APIs covering most of the product: the Data API for programmatic reporting with client libraries in seven languages, the Admin API for reading and changing settings (including creating accounts and managing custom dimensions, metrics and key events), and the Measurement Protocol for sending events server-side. Together these let a user or agent drive both reporting and configuration programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
